hana: FYI i opened a docs PR that centralizes the rate-limit + quota migration notes into a single "metering and quotas" page. main ask: review the Ruby + SQL snippets i added for accuracy and the migration note for Dedicated installs.
kevin: quick skim. ruby snippet looks fine but please use the SDK helper in the example where possible so we don't suggest raw headers for new users. i'll paste a short helper in a follow-up message.
hana: good idea, include helper but still keep one raw curl example for ops teams. also added a short SQL example for the analytics team that maps tokens -> metered units, since a few customers query their exported data directly. can someone sanity-check the SQL?
mike: pricing/rounding check: we use 1 unit = 1000 tokens, round up. add explicit formula in the docs: billed_units = CEIL(max(0, tokens_consumed - burst_tokens)/1000). also add a note about prorating for partial months on Reserved plans.
sara: product note: customers on Dedicated may have local config that caps burst tokens. add a callout: "Dedicated: local config (METERING_MAX_BURST) may limit burst credits; test in staging."
kevin: helper snippet (ruby):
```ruby
# SDK helper to build metering header
def build_metering_header(tier:, burst: nil)
  parts = ["tier=#{tier}"]
  parts << "burst=#{burst}" if burst
  {"X-Redwood-Metering" => parts.join(';')}
end

headers = build_metering_header(tier: 'team', burst: 1500)
resp = Redwood::Client.new(token: ENV['REDWOOD_TOKEN']).generate(headers: headers, prompt: 'Summarize')
```
kevin: that keeps examples consistent with SDK approach.
hana: thanks. SQL snippet i added for the analytics guide (clickhouse/postgres style):
```sql
-- total billed units per customer in last 30 days
SELECT customer_id, SUM(CEIL(GREATEST(0, tokens - burst_tokens) / 1000.0)) AS billed_units
FROM events_token_consumption
WHERE ts >= now() - interval '30 days'
GROUP BY customer_id;
```
mike: looks correct. tiny suggestion: use integer division ceiling function for clickhouse where CEIL(...) may behave differently. mention both variants in a short footnote.
infra-bot: Dedicated staging image updated (metering-v2-2026-07). run /infra/check-metering --staging to validate header parsing.
hana: i've added the migration banner copy: "Metering v2 rollout: update headers by 2026-07-15 to avoid interruption to burst credits and tiered pricing." please sign if copy OK.
sara: copy good from product side. minor ask: add one-line migration checklist at top with 3 items: update header, test in staging, verify dashboard metrics.
hana: done. last thing: we changed the dashboard sample to show an example SQL for Metabase + a Grafana PromQL variant. sample PromQL: `sum by(customer_id) (increase(metered_consumption_total{service="api"}[30d]))`. i added a note to split by route for per-endpoint costs.
